result:
**Verdict: PASS for DG1 round 16** (task T-DG1-REV-DOM-R16, candidate `sha256:56f3eb885c6cf3db…2b4c`, 391 files). The round-16 repair checks out, I found no regressions, and I raised no new findings.

**Candidate.** HEAD is `aa7d9a8`, the freeze commit. It differs from `13418b8` only in files excluded from the candidate. The candidate ID recomputes the same in the repository and in a full disposable clone. Outside `docs/delivery`, the only changes since round 15 are `architecture.testkit.ts` and `architecture.test.ts`. No product, runtime, API, data model, i18n, source or config file changed, and `vitest.config.ts` is untouched.

**F-DG1-137 / F-DG1-218 (Low, same root cause): fixed.** My verifications sidecar closes both as CLOSED_VERIFIED.
- **Classification:** the lint now decides which files are declaration files using TypeScript's own rule instead of a hand-written pattern. Over 22 test names, it gave the same answer as TypeScript's internal `ts.isDeclarationFileName` every time (0 mismatches).
- **Still scanned:** my own probe placed real `.d.css.ts`, `.d.json.ts`, `.d.ts.ts` and `.d.html.ts` files, plus `.d.ts`, `.d.mts` and `.d.cts`, in `modules/kpi`. For each one:
  - a deep cross-module type import was reported, and so was an import of the composition root;
  - a syntax error gave a named "unparseable source" message instead of a crash;
  - a clean file gave no violations.
  
  It passed 30/30 on Node 22 and on Node 24.
- **Control:** the same probe against the round-15 lint fails exactly the 16 arbitrary-extension cases with "Debug Failure", which reproduces the original defect.

**No regression** (both Node versions unless noted):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Unit tests | 325/325 |
| Architecture tests | 132/132 |
| Integration tests (throwaway PostgreSQL 16) | 200/200, no leftover databases |
| Live Arabic/English stack (Node 24) | 108/108 |
| No-CDN, OpenAPI lint, typecheck, lint, format | all exit 0 |

- **Live behaviour:** closing a transformation by a status edit is refused with 422 and cites the G6 business approval, and nothing is written. Out-of-scope reads return 404, and permitted-read-but-no-write returns 403. Cursor pagination is consistent and tampered cursors get a 400. Sign-in and sign-out behave correctly. I looked at the Arabic edit screen and the English detail screen myself. Arabic renders right-to-left and English left-to-right. Missing data shows "Unknown". Branding is marked provisional, and there is no request to an outside server.
- **Claims:** every mention of "official", "certified" or "PMI" is a disclaimer. There are no float money columns, and the playbook and other source files are unchanged.
- **Register:** it is unchanged. The 8 assigned rows and all 12 rows due at DG1 are IMPLEMENTED, with every evidence file present. The 29 rows due at later gates stay SPECIFIED, so nothing is claimed early. Earlier domain fixes (F-DG1-001…011, 105, 131–136, 207, 209, 210, 216, 217) still hold. No Critical, High or mandatory finding is open.

**Findings:** none new. The only DG1 findings still open were F-DG1-137 and F-DG1-218, which this review verifies.

**Housekeeping:** the record passes the repository's own schema check, and every evidence path exists. I ran everything in a disposable clone and removed it afterwards. HEAD and the candidate ID were unchanged at the end, and nothing tracked in the repository was modified. I read no other reviewer's round-16 record, and I granted no business approvals.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG1/round-16/`:
- `domain-reviewer.json`
- `domain-reviewer.verifications.json`
- `domain-reviewer.md`

The evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/domain/round-16/`.
